headline: Grok Build coding agent leaks confidential data, including SpaceXSI's
summary: A flaw in the Grok Build vibe-coding agent left tens of thousands of apps wide open, leaking confidential and sensitive data from thousands of users, including data belonging to SpaceXSI, a researcher found.

claims.statement: A flaw in the Grok Build coding agent leaked confidential data, including data belonging to SpaceXSI.

sources.quote: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
A Grok vibe-coding agent leaked sensitive SpaceXSI data
A flaw in SpaceXSI's Grok Build vibe-coding agent allowed sensitive data to leak from thousands of users including... SpaceXSI.

claims.statement: A researcher found 35,000 Grok Build apps left wide open to anyone looking for them.
